stem.en: A monatomic gas (like helium) and a diatomic gas (like nitrogen) are at the same temperature. Which has more internal energy per molecule, and why?
stem.et: Ühe aatomiga gaas (nagu heelium) ja kaheaatomiline gaas (nagu lämmastik) on samal temperatuuril. Kummal on molekuli kohta rohkem siseenergiat ja miks?

label.en: The diatomic gas — it has rotational degrees of freedom in addition to translation, each carrying its own share of thermal energy
label.et: Kaheaatomilisel gaasil — sellel on lisaks translatsioonile ka pöörlemise vabadusastmed, millest kumbki kannab oma osa soojusenergiast

label.en: Both have exactly the same internal energy, since they are at the same temperature
label.et: Mõlemal on täpselt sama siseenergia, sest need on samal temperatuuril

label.en: The monatomic gas, since it is structurally simpler and therefore stores energy more efficiently
label.et: Ühe aatomiga gaasil, sest see on struktuurilt lihtsam ja seega talletab energiat tõhusamalt

label.en: It depends only on molar mass, not on molecular structure
label.et: See sõltub ainult moolmassist, mitte molekuli struktuurist
